about: Where every file in the factory asset library comes from, so any session can rebuild HEARTSIDE_ASSETS with factory/fetch_library.py. The library itself stays out of git (the repository is public and some audio is licensed). Renders are checked against factory/bank/renders.json.
renders: every file in factory/bank/renders.json, from the live store's product images (heartside.io/products/<handle>.json)

p04-frenchie-window.jpg.what: a brindle frenchie squished on a fogged window, lips clamped, eyes on a van

p04-driver-waves.jpg.what: through the window: a delivery driver waving, a box on the step, a brindle frenchie ear in front

p04-frenchie-bark.jpg.what: the same brindle frenchie mid-bark at the window, mouth wide, a van leaving
